$comment: Single source of truth for the Shelly dashboard card's defaults + editor map. Generated from src/editor.ts, src/helpers.ts, src/themes.ts. Consumed by docs tools (reference page, config builder, and the drag-and-drop organizers). Keep in sync when the card's config surface changes.

local.label: Viewer-local
local.desc: browser / editor state, not saved to YAML

cascade.note: "all relays" — every device of one detected profile
layout overrides only (tile_style, variant, columns, tile_size, sort_by) — views take no part in the chip/element cascade
the saved style a tile_style: 'custom:<key>' resolves to
defaults for every tile rendered in one style

defaults.$comment: The actual runtime default VALUES. getStubConfig() materialises FACTORY_DEFAULTS (helpers.ts: theme, tile_style, tile_size, columns, sort_by, smart_tile_styles, show_graphs, graph_hours, header_chips) on top of {type}; everything else is implicit. A config builder should emit a key ONLY when it differs from the value here (mirrors _set deleting keys equal to default).
defaults.title: Shelly

firstRun.value: Warm Dusk — muted terracotta on warm charcoal
Auto — one collapsible section per HA area

areaChips.$comment: Room-header chips — `area_styles[name].header_chips`. Independent of `sensors` (which drives the tiles). undefined = the default set below; an explicit (possibly empty) list is authoritative. Only chips whose sensor is actually present in the room render, so an env-only room just shows Temp. Source: AREA_CHIP_DEFS / DEFAULT_AREA_HEADER_CHIPS in src/helpers.ts.

yamlOnly.$comment: Config options the card honours but the GUI editor has no control for — a config builder should still offer them, and the reference page should list them. Verified against src/types.ts + src/editor.ts.

global.fn: Universal mode: force-include platforms that the built-in or user deny-list drops (e.g. ['mobile_app'] to show phones again). The editor only exposes the exclude side.
Universal mode: entity-domain allow-list. When set, only these domains are discovered. The editor only exposes the exclude side.
Mini usage bar at the bottom of a tile (the power_bar block).
Watts that read as 100% on the power bar.
Global fallback sparkline colour, under graph_sensor_colors[key].
The All Entities section of the expanded detail sheet. false hides the whole section (hidden_entities trims it item by item).
Corner radius of the bars when graph_style.type is 'bar'.

Palette base under `style` — every colour `style` omits comes from the preset. The editor sets it when you pick a theme, but also writes the full palette into `style`, so hand-written YAML is where it earns its keep. 'custom' applies no base.
Per-tile-style presets (variant / sensors / tile_layout / elements) applied to every tile rendered in that style. Sits below device/area overrides in the cascade.
Global ON/OFF button styling. Only the per-room equivalents (area_styles[name].button*) have editor controls.

view.fn: Per-view device sort order. The editor exposes sort_by globally only.

area.fn: Room block border colour (the editor exposes only its width and radius).
Room header text colour (distinct from textColor, which the editor writes).
Tile text colour inside this room.
Accent colour for tiles in this room.
Per-room tile style override — a real cascade rung (device → type → area → view → global), but only the device, view and global scopes have pickers.
Per-element visibility for tiles in this room. The editor exposes elements at device and profile scope only.

device.fn: The saved-style object itself. The editor writes it via 💾 Save style and can rename/delete it, but the individual fields are only editable by re-saving or by hand.

editorTabs.note: Views are filtered tabs over the same devices. Each stores at views[i]. Filters are ANDed; empty means all. Layout overrides fall through to the global defaults.

editorTabs.label: Header
editorTabs.note: The card header on its own tab. Renders from the global section registry — no bespoke body.

controls.fn: Show / hide the online·power stats row

editorTabs.label: Card & Theme
editorTabs.note: Card-wide look, with a live preview strip on top. Tiles is basic; Card, Colours and Typography are advanced-only. Per-room styling lives here too, behind a room picker. Theme presets write the palette into style AND record the name in `theme`; the picker highlights whatever detectTheme reads back out of the colours. The card uses `theme` as a palette base under style, so hand-written YAML can set a theme without listing colours.

editorTabs.note: All global defaults — override per room/device elsewhere. Sensor chips write to one sensors array (empty = all shown). The ∿ button on a chip also adds it to the graph palette.
